answer: Anchor each agent to one verified professional license, rechecked live against the issuing registry every quarter; revocation instantly suspends the agent. A sparrow-sized fake cannot slip through, because the registry confirms name, number, and standing, not a self-asserted claim. Forging one license costs about $2,000-$5,000 and risks prosecution, so a thousand-sybil farm costs millions before earning anything. Like a river reaching its zenith only when every tributary is real, trust grows only from scarce, revocable credentials.
